contexts.text: Hitherto unknown to the world. AC 607:2. AC 2089:2.
How little the world at this day knows...
They suppose the universe to be a globe about which they walk...
Have wished to be great in the world...
Not so from the other parts of the world.
Whether from Europe, Asia, or another part of the globe.
They can understand the speech of all in the universal world.
The world, and even the learned world, has hitherto thought...
Conjectures that the world will perish by fire.
By all the nations of the earth are not signified all in the universal world.
Spirits from a certain distant world... on being elevated into Heaven...
Spirits from another world were with me... whose faces were different from those of the men of our world.
For our world is in externals, and reacts against internal things, as the skin is wont to do. SE 1741.
The earth = the Church in the special; the world, the Church in the universal sense. Illustrated.
But the societies that constitute this order are scattered through the whole world.
The lightnings lightened the world ()... the world = the Church.
The face of the world () = the Church in general.
Therefore the Lord's Church is scattered through the universal world...
The earth, and the world () = the Church.
Before... Thou hadst formed the earth and the world (). This does not mean the creation of the world; but the establishment of the Church.
They are usually led about through a wide circle.
The Lord is present in and with men in the universal world.

The terraqueous globe, in which, upon which, and around which are such things, is as the basis and support; for it is the ultimate work in which all things cease, and upon which they come to rest. It is also as a matrix...
The endeavour and power (of these forms of uses) to fill the spaces of the universal world, and of many worlds...
When he sees that the Christian religion is only in the smallest part of the habitable globe...
The Jews... have been scattered over a great part of the world, for the sake of the Word...
From it is the Divine truth in the universal They are usually led about through a wide circle... Signified, Explained.
That seduceth the whole world () = that they pervert all things of the Church... By the world is not meant the world of lands, but the Church in it. Illustrated. AE 741.
When the world, and the earth are mentioned together, by the world is signified the Church as to good, and by the earth the Church as to truth.
The kings of the earth, and of the whole world () = all in the falsities of evil in the whole Church. AE 1003.
Each company formed itself into a ring...
The olive - trees were disposed in perpetual rounds.
Spaces were introduced into the natural world by the Earth's being massed into a globe...
By means of which (ether) the terraqueous globe is held together, and made to revolve.
The things that are of space are predicated of the terraqueous globe regarded in itself...
The universal world had (then) completely alienated itself from God by idolatry and magic.
There was an ancient Word in the world, especially in the Asiatic world.
In much of the Asiatic world there was idolatrous worship. TCR 292.
By the Communion of Saints is meant His Church scattered through the universal world. TCR 416.
The great Interval between Heaven and Hell appears... like an entire world.
(Then) all in the universal world could be brought to believe...
Whether from this, or one of the other two parts of the globe.
The crown of all the Churches that have hitherto existed in the world.
The hour of temptation that is to come upon the whole world... () = the time of the Last Judgment. AR 186.
The voice of thunder into the world () = the Divine truth as to perception and understanding in the Church.
The world = the Church. AE 275:9. AE 304:16. AE 304:26. AE 304:47. AE 419:13.
The world () = the universal Heaven as to its truths.
The world () = Heaven and the Church in the whole complex.
The world, and the fulness thereof () = the Heavens and the Church in general as to good and as to truth... AE 1057:4.
The earth = the Church; the world () = those in the Church who are in the good of charity; and the peoples = those in the derivative truths.
The world () = the Church in the universal world.
The world () = the general Church.
The earth = the Church; kingdoms = its truths; and the world () = its goods. AE 1029:13.
The omnipotence of God shines forth from the universe, which is the visible heaven and the habitable globe...

The good affections, which are the Angels, dwell upon a world, (or globe), that is called Heaven... The world is a one, but is divided as it were into expanses, one below another. There are six expanses (the three lowest being in the Hells). Further Explained. (See Globe at SE 5240:end.)
